known_unknowns: The lexical inventories map detected function calls, M01 inputs, M01/M02 types and M03 global identifiers. They do not yet classify read/write ownership for every nested state field or aliases; consumer_edges remains PARTIAL.
M11J is present in Build 5.15 and is now enumerated. D1O-01 is the approved execution-decision evidence; no standalone M11J module contract is linked in this graph.
The two declared BlockNMJEConflict/BlockNMJEBuilding inputs have no code reader; M01 labels them INACTIVE legacy compatibility because NMJE is observation-only.
Only identified direct function calls and owner-state handoffs are listed; an absent edge is not proof of no dependency outside the recorded lexical inventory.
M09 has no standalone lifecycle contract. C_D1 is the D1 Extreme/TP-Wajib contract and is not M09 contract evidence.
M18 has no caller in the pinned Build 5.15 execution path; confirm whether a display/telemetry consumer is intended.
Build 5.15 M06 incomplete-history validity defect is confirmed. The repair and targeted tests exist only in Draft PR #293 / Build 5.20.
Targeted regression assignments remain PARTIAL and no mandatory global regression command is VERIFIED.
M12 unreadable-refresh admission remains VERIFICATION REQUIRED until an end-to-end H1/H4 stale-owner path is reproduced.

connection_inventory.method: Lexical static scan of module headers, detected function definitions and direct calls, M01 input declarations, M01/M02 enum/struct declarations, and M03 g_* identifiers. Comments and quoted strings excluded from reference scans. Direct-call function pairs are unique caller/callee names; actual cross-module occurrences are counted separately. Global references are not classified as reads vs writes; aliases and nested struct-field ownership are not fully resolved.
